| File | Change |
|---|---|

Mirrors `shop.ts`'s pattern: loads character via `getCharacter`, computes cost (e.g. flat `10` gp or `character.level * 10`), checks `character.gold >= cost` (else 400), then `db.batch`/`updateCharacter` to set `hp = max_hp` and deduct `gold`, returns `{ success, updatedCharacter }`. |

| **`worker/src/db/seed.sql`** | Only if adding an `inns` table with seed rows (name/location/cost), following the `shops`/`shop_inventory` seed pattern. |

## Frontend (Angular)

| File | Change |
|---|---|
| **`frontend/src/app/services/game-api.service.ts`** | Add `restAtInn(sessionId, characterId): Observable<{ success: boolean; updatedCharacter: Character }>` calling `POST ${API_BASE}/api/inn/rest`. |
| **`frontend/src/app/models/game.models.ts`** | No new model strictly required (reuses `Character`); add a `REST_COST` constant if the cost is needed client-side for display/validation. |

| **`frontend/src/app/components/game-console/game-console.component.html`** | Add a "Rest at Inn" button in `sidebar-actions` (next to Inventory button), disabled when `loading()` or insufficient gold. |
